verdict.rationale: Community geekbench data shows ~15% multi-core uplift over M4 and a claimed 15% faster multithreaded CPU performance, giving some independent corroboration of multi-core gains, and Apple docs mention GPU/Neural Engine core counts (10-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine). However, explicit CPU core-count documentation and boost-clock behavior are absent from the evidence, and compile/heavy-parallel-job workloads (e.g., codebase builds) aren't directly benchmarked. missing for 10: CPU core count specs, boost clock documentation, real-world compile/build benchmark data.
